text:
anya: FYI overnight link-scan flagged ~22 broken links across runtime + onboarding. not urgent outage-level but a sprint-sized tidy. who can pick small chunks?
link-scan-bot: automated report: 22 issues found in /runtime and /onboarding. details: https://intranet/reports/720202 (scheduled scan) :robot_face:
sam: I can grab runtime.md, batching, and the YAML snippets. will do small atomic PRs (<=5 files).
maria: Ill take onboarding screenshots and any shortlink swaps. I can rehost to docs-assets or update to canonical external URLs.
anya: perfect. Sam, loop in Lucas for runtime CRs (he altered the YAML examples in Q4).
sam: @lucas can you review `docs/runtime/batching.md` and `docs/runtime/kv-cache.md`? mostly sed fixes + image rehosts. Branching: `docs/linkfix/7202020202-scan`.
lucas: yep. prefer rehosting images to `s3://redwood-docs-assets` with public-read and adding provenance in PR description. for many callers (runbooks) we should prefer frontmatter redirects to avoid touching caller pages.
devex: local helpers: `./scripts/link-check --path docs/runtime` or `rg -n "href=|src=.*s3" docs/ | sed -n '1,120p'`. also `./bin/preview-docs docs/runtime/batching.md` to confirm rendered anchors.
maria: PR checklist for small fixes: - reproduce link failure locally - confirm owner via CODEOWNERS or frontmatter - choose rehost vs canonical vs redirect - keep PR under 5 files when possible - add label `kb:high-priority` if runbook/customer path
anya: branch naming and labels matter. use `docs/linkfix/<scan-ts>` and add `kb:urgent` for runbooks or external-facing docs. if it affects an SRE runbook ping #eng-oncall.
sam: opening PRs now. small note: some anchors shifted after the TOC refactor; is frontmatter redirect ok for runbooks with many inbound links?
anya: yes for runbooks prefer frontmatter redirects when caller count is large and it's low risk. otherwise update callers if callers are few.
lucas: quick point: if we rehost images, include original filename and source in PR so legal/ownership can trace it.
devex: adding anchor-lint to the backlog (warn mode first). until then please run preview + link-check locally.
sam: PR 3290 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3290  sed + image rehost. assigned to @lucas.
maria: PR 3291 opened for onboarding shortlinks and two image rehosts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3291.
link-scan-bot: follow-up scan scheduled in 24h. results will be posted to #docs.
anya: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate follow-ups with legal on any asset provenance questions.
